status_detail: Google confirmed plans for a LaGrange data center after reports tied it to an active construction site at 411 Pegasus Parkway. DCD reports the 270-acre site had been owned by Thor/Form8tion and was targeting 100 MW capacity; local/industry reports describe ongoing construction and Google confirmation in April 2026.
notes: Capacity recorded as 100 MW based on DCD/Thor target and 100 MVA substation reporting; other trackers list higher planned figures, so verify with permits/utility filings before using for capacity totals.

developer: Project West WHP - GA LLC / Joshua Harrelson
status_detail: A six-building, 513-acre data center/technology campus was proposed near LaGrange with 600 MW capacity and roughly $6B-$9.7B investment. Reporting says the project filed a Georgia DRI in March 2025; Troup County later adopted and extended a data-center moratorium through June 14, 2026, and tracker/news reports indicate the project has faced annexation/regulatory delay.
notes: FOX 5 gives 600 MW, 513 acres, six 250k-sf buildings and $9.7B over a decade. DCD reports six 252k-sf buildings, 1.5M sf, DRI filing, phases 2028/2030/2033, and $6B filing value. Status kept planned/on-hold rather than approved.

project_name: Unnamed Hightower Road / Hogansville data center
status_detail: GPB/Ledger-Enquirer reporting describes a proposed 600 MW data center affecting Hightower Road land near Hogansville, with surrounding properties in Troup County; the MEAG study reportedly found no current generation for 600 MW and estimated a four-to-five-year service timeline after funding. The Hogansville council had not put a zoning change on an agenda as of the report.
notes: May overlap with Project West in some community trackers, but location details in local reporting point to Hightower Road/Hogansville rather than the LaGrange/Hamilton Road Project West site; kept separate as a low-confidence distinct lead.
